purpose: Retrospective contextual peer reference; not a match-date forecast or a causal pressure effect.
partition_rule: Within family/year, sort matches by SHA256(salt + ':' + match_id), then assign alternating folds 0 and 1. Fit on the opposite fold. Both innings stay together. Never choose a seed using outcomes.
expectation_weights: Equal role opportunities within each training partition; no target-driven weights. The year hierarchy captures the contemporary environment, with disclosed shrinkage toward the development partition global mean.
support_policy: Require at least 95% finest-cell support in each year/family/role, separately for all and pressure opportunities, and same-year/family parent support for every opportunity. These are feasibility screens, not accuracy claims. No dropping unsupported events to manufacture a pass.
validation: Use the original MSE/Brier, calibration tolerances, sample minima and whole-match bootstrap. Compare against opposite-fold same-year global and same-year/family means. Require pooled loss no worse for every target and at least two of three annual global comparisons; no material calibration alerts in pooled or separately reported evaluation-fold screens. Historical v1/v2 comparisons remain diagnostics because the estimand changed.
development_scales: Freeze SD of development out-of-fold residuals per target, floors 0.05 runs and 0.01 wickets, only after the development gate passes. No reserved outcomes enter these scales.
reserved_policy: After the development gate and scale freeze, repeat the identical two-partition procedure within 2026. Each evaluated match is excluded from all reference means and priors. Other-fold 2026 outcomes are reference data, so this is reserved-procedure retrospective cross-validation, not a 2026 outcome-free forecast. No changes after inspecting reserved outcomes.

budget.explanation: Explicit small amendment to the project's internal hard cap, within the user's approximately-20 preference. Each development bundle is one four-target model trained on one complete-match partition pooled across 2023-2025, with year in the hierarchy; it is not three annual fits or hundreds of hidden leave-match-out models. Reserved evaluation requires two more bundles. No full-data refit.

failure_policy: Preserve any failed gate. Do not tune the partition, prior, pressure rules, calibration tolerances or eligibility, and do not fit another candidate automatically.
